text.raster_limit: Visible punctuation classes are transcribed; original Unicode code points cannot be certified from raster marks.

style.observations: Gray photographs and black-on-white text; no visible hue, sepia, ominous vignette or commercial ornament.

substantive_non_glyph.observations: Upper lever and lower inserted key photographs take about 63% of height and remain content-specific large forms.

layout_fidelity.observations: Two independent photo regions and all visit copy between them; same central grouping and clear photo/type gaps.

hangul.observations: Natural square proportions, visible counters and distinct word gaps retained; detail readable in usage720.

function_contact.observations: Lever grip and rotation mount, cylinder/keyway and inserted shaft remain visible. The intended wear positions remain less isolated because of pervasive texture.

local_material_edge_finish.observations: Chip islands reduced; repeated fine wavy texture on the grip, protected neck and key center remains.

located_observations.observation: Large chipped-looking dark islands have been replaced with a more continuous metal tonal field; its highlight is broad and smooth-looking at usage size. Dense wavy fine texture remains across the grip.
The key head center is less mottled; brighter perimeter and hole edge remain. Fine similar wavy texture occupies almost the whole head.
All seven entries are readable in the same grouping and their observed transcription matches the required text under the predeclared normalization. Address stays on one line.
Syllable counters remain open, letter proportions natural and word boundaries clear. The clean black type and full central white area are retained.
The upper long lever and lower inserted key remain the dominant nonletter subjects; central title links the two independent views.
Hardware attachment and continuous insertion are retained; no loose floating key, extra props or decorative marks appear.

residuals.location: Upper lever grip and protected neck; lower key head center
residuals.observation: Dark flaking-looking islands are reduced, but closely spaced wavy scratch/etch marks still cover almost every part of the grip and head, including protected areas. Both surfaces now have similar fine pattern scale.
residuals.impact: The broad smooth touched patch versus narrow smooth touched rim is still less distinct than specified.

residuals.location: Lower cylinder face and outer plate
residuals.observation: Dense scratch lines occupy much of the cylinder and plate, making protective and touched areas similarly weathered.
residuals.impact: Material finish competes with the contact-specific interpretation.

residuals.location: Central information area, detailed visit information
residuals.observation: The large title and both objects remain evident; small detail text is comfortable at usage720 and less comfortable at thumbnail size.
residuals.impact: All-detail readability is attested at usage720, not every possible display size.
